notes.title: Membership for everyone!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/aabe011675675d25084c8e1c3d26d144466fe6eb.png[/img]

New accounts now get membership to experience all of the fun features in World of Squares!

Go to Cubetown and fight knights in the arena.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/b1a5d570a71f825dbac08ceb3ea983f5da8d952a.png[/img]
Or go fight the flying Wyrm and have a chance at a mount.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/d807b44736b547e04fb59147e8be6c89145aaf72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/a26abc16dc5606816cc18d2da60d324920e56601.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/1bc8445e37459496b4a39ec853f4aa878c261298.png[/img]

- Thanks to payl reporting a bug of a white screen and sending the log, I fixed the game not working on their AMD graphics card. (Game development advice: With OpenGL drivers, AMD graphics cards always break, NVIDIA cards always work. So you want to develop on an AMD card to catch the bugs.)

notes.title: Winterdungeon
notes.content:
Winterdungeon is here. A dungeon accessible only by Winterflower. Plant a seed and have a chance at the new best unique items in the game.

A cube made this map to help adventurers find their way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/df99fbb1d5ffedce526705ad0a5eaf0eef9305d6.png[/img]

Icepal does a lot of "dungeon-looking" and can help you with the specifics near the dungeon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/1bc8445e37459496b4a39ec853f4aa878c261298.png[/img]

if you are lucky you might get...
- a new level crystal (which provides a max health and stash slot)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/f89a6f38d47bfbd59c533275f70e5e98cbed2e53.png[/img]
- an upgrade to the firecube spell; twice AS much damage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/b26fecd3ad4396cb7ef78eea5b982515411415c4.png[/img]
- a new area OF effect sword that spawns 9 icicles with massive delayed damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/363f67507b5a6e0e846aa4bedee315df4ed229eb.png[/img]


Additional changes:
- An awesome happy fox with a sword fills the niche for an adventuring emote
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136870/53df22662d337a6c42867c6668be9c36fc41b5c9.png[/img]
- Some drops have been changed to 1-in-x which you can see in the drop tables menu.
- Dash spell does melee damage instead of magic.
- Fixed NPCs wandering too far from their spawn.
- You can now talk to Collie at the park to remove your collar if you have a key.
- There's now a news viewer in-game!

Watch the new trailer here, which has some of my animation work:
[previewyoutube=ohl_eUDTNX4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Put collars on your friends and drag them around
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hvOAhb1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0t7NqXT.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uvMa7LQ.gif[/img]

- Added collars that your friends can put on you. (much easier to get on than off...) (NOTE: right now collar keys don't work, so you better hope whoever put on your collar is willing to take them off, until the next update.)
- Added Collie in Cubetown Park who tells you about collars
- Added winterland, with the winterflower (whose seed comes from the Dangerous Vines boss)
- Made transparent rendering appear nicer (though is still a little pixel inaccurate; just pre-alpha stuff)
- Fixed wheat not rendering
- Bug fix with crafting
